sample_facts.fact: Lumentum reported fiscal fourth quarter fiscal 2026 net revenue of $1.01 billion.
Lumentum reported GAAP gross margin of 47.4% and non-GAAP gross margin of 50.4% for its fiscal fourth quarter 2026.
Lumentum reported GAAP operating margin of 27.8% and non-GAAP operating margin of 36.6% for its fiscal fourth quarter 2026.
Lumentum guided first quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $1.225 billion to $1.275 billion.
Lumentum guided first quarter fiscal 2027 non-GAAP operating margin of 39.5% to 40.5%.
Lumentum guided first quarter fiscal 2027 non-GAAP diluted net income per share of $4.05 to $4.35.
Lumentum stated it is advancing 1.6T adoption in its cloud module business.
Lumentum cited increasing demand for ultra-high-power CPO lasers and an initial order for ELS modules.
